recommendations: Ryan Tran “I had the joy of studying with Phu as peers @ CSULB in various classes, participating in a SWE cohort together, and working on the same team for our computing club, ACM. Through these experiences, Phu has shown outstanding resilience, dedication, and consistency. He is true to his word, deadline, and expectations which made working alongside him very rewarding and fun. I highly recommend Phu for any position, he WILL adapt.”

Krrish Kohli “I had the privilege of working with Phu during his time as Vice President of ACM at CSULB and as a Beach Hack Lead. Phu consistently demonstrated exceptional leadership, organization, and dedication to the student tech community. As Vice President, he helped guide ACM’s vision, supporting both officers and members in creating meaningful events and opportunities for students to learn and grow. His ability to communicate clearly and inspire collaboration made a noticeable impact on the chapter’s success. At BeachHacks, Phu took his leadership further by coordinating teams, managing logistics, and ensuring participants had a smooth and engaging hackathon experience. His problem-solving mindset and calm under pressure helped the team overcome challenges and deliver a high-quality event. Phu is a natural leader who balances technical knowledge with people skills. He empowers those around him and leads by example. I’m confident he will excel in any professional or academic environment he chooses to pursue.”
